description: The agent must: (1) Locate the existing ~/nutrition/ workspace and understand its structure from SKILL.md. (2) Create ~/nutrition/daily/2024-03/2024-03-15.md with correctly structured meal sections (## Breakfast — 8:30 AM, ## Lunch — 12:30 PM, ## Dinner — 7:00 PM), per-item bullet macros, a '## Daily Totals' section with 'Calories: X,XXX' and pipe-separated 'Protein: Xg | Carbs: Xg | Fat: Xg', and a '## Micronutrients Notable' section with at least 2 bullet points noting micronutrient sources (e.g., iron from lentils/spinach, Vitamin C from broccoli). (3) Compare computed totals against ~/nutrition/targets.md (2000 cal, 150g P, 200g C, 65g F) and produce gap-analysis language per the 'What To Surface' template (e.g., 'You've had Xg protein, Yg to go' or 'low on Vitamin D'). (4) Update ~/nutrition/foods/common.md's pipe-delimited Quick Reference table with new foods (e.g., Lentils 100g, Sweet potato 100g) while preserving the exact table format. (5) Append new observations to ~/nutrition/insights.md under Patterns or Adjustments. The key proprietary traps are: the exact directory path (daily/2024-03/), the comma-formatted Calories line, the pipe-separated macro totals line, the 'What To Surface' phrasing for gap analysis, and the pipe-table format in common.md.
